map_features.note: OSW offshore eastern-Adriatic reference corridor under the Otranto-to-Istria surface-circulation convention. Gates are editorial neighborhoods, not observed origins or termination. Excludes western return flow, sub-basin recirculation loops and unverified island-channel branches. The possible Dalmatian-name overlap is unresolved and its extent is not transferred. The published 800 km basin length is not used as current length; this estimate comes from the declared OSW vertices.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

scope_notes.label: East Adriatic naming and extent convention
scope_notes.source_locator: Section 2.1 and Figure 1 caption: northwestward eastern-coast EAC, separate southeastward western-coast WAC, three sub-basin recirculations, wind modulation.
scope_notes.summary: Eastern-coast northwestward circulation convention is distinct from the western return and basin gyres. Otranto-to-Istria context is not a diagnosed whole-current axis; Dalmatian-name overlap remains unresolved, and 800 km basin length is not current length.

ordering_sensitivity.interpretation: Conservative positions within retained rounded route envelopes, treating choices independently; touching envelopes overlap. Not a statistical rank interval or a uniform whole-current comparison.

remaining_gates: Resolve Dalmatian-name overlap before canonical naming/extent admission.
Review island passages and bathymetry with finer geography and compatible surface-current data; coarse land clearance is insufficient.
Retrieve original 2002-2003 measurements and basin drifter study before claiming diagnosed whole-current or seasonal geometry.
Do not transfer 800 km basin length, basin width, qualitative current broadening or seasonal strength into current dimensions.

widths.boundary_rule: Author-described limit of coastal inflow belonging to EAC; no numerical velocity threshold, coastline-edge reconstruction or perpendicular correction extracted.
widths.extraction_method: Numerical prose descriptor transcribed from reviewed original. Source figures inspected for context only; no curve or velocity boundaries digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: Primosten southwestward cross-section over the Middle Adriatic Pit, between Blitvenica and Jabuka; first approximately 10 km from the eastern coast.
widths.layer: Vessel ADCP sampled 10-70 m in 4 m bins; author does not specify paired edges at a fixed depth. Figure 1 arrows represent 10 m despite surface placement.
widths.name: East Adriatic Current

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: East Adriatic Current: about 10 km coastal inflow extent during 24-28 May 2017 near Primosten. Local ADCP description, not whole-current or annual width.
original_regional_context.display_caption: C1, 24-28 May 2017: inflow identified as part of EAC was confined to roughly the first 10 km offshore. This is a local coastal extent, with exact width occupation day unresolved.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: ADCP sampled 10-70 m; plotted surface arrows represent 10 m. The 20 km upwelling/pycnocline extent is a different object. C2 supplies no numeric EAC width, so no annual or seasonal range is inferred.
original_regional_context.quality_note: Author conference abstract and figure inspected; one local reported extent, no raw ADCP data or thresholded boundary pair. Exact width day and width at each sampled depth not independently resolved.

widths.range_interpretation: Author-reported local descriptor. No statistical error, full-current inference or annual range supplied.
remaining_gates: Independent review of source naming, metric and local support before canonical admission.

widths.section_orientation: Author cross-section descriptor; no independent perpendicular correction or paired edge extraction.
widths.source_citation: Pasaric, Z., H. Mihanovic and M. Orlic (2019), Spatial variability of pycnocline in the springtime East Adriatic, Rapp. Comm. int. Mer Medit. 42, p38. Complete congress abstract volume retained; only the one-page authored abstract reviewed.
widths.source_locator: CIESM volume 42 (2019), printed p38 / PDF 38, methods and final current paragraph; Figure 1 caption.
widths.source_quality_note: Author conference abstract and figure inspected; one local reported extent, no raw ADCP data or thresholded boundary pair. Exact width day and width at each sampled depth not independently resolved.
widths.time_convention: C1 cruise 24-28 May 2017; plotted section28 May 2017. Numeric prose extent belongs to C1; exact width occupation day unresolved. C2 June 2018 is not a second numeric width.
